name: Imgify
summary: Shopify app that drops your own logo, or snow, hearts and dozens of holiday presets, down the storefront, with a marquee slider for partner, payment and press logos and an AI logo maker for the artwork.
best_for: shopify stores that want their own logo falling down the page, or a marquee of partner, payment and press logos, rather than generic snow, and that have no artwork ready, since the AI logo maker is the one thing here the free competitors do not offer
skip_if: you only want seasonal snow, hearts or confetti: Dakaas Seasonal Effects does exactly that for nothing, with 200+ themes and a far deeper review record, and skip it too if you are counting on the free plan, which is restricted to development and partner stores and starts billing the moment you upgrade
honest_knock:
Start with the word 'free' on the listing card, because it does not mean what it looks like. The free plan is development and partner stores only, and billing activates the moment you upgrade: a real storefront pays $4.99 from the first day, after a 7-day trial (it was $2.99 until November 2026), and in our test of 17 November 2026 the app did not offer the free plan at all.

Then the harder question: the nearest app in the same Shopify category costs nothing. Dakaas Seasonal Effects carries the same Built for Shopify badge, lists 200+ holiday themes plus cursor effects, music and scheduling, and has 1,567 reviews at 4.9 since May 2021 against Imgify's 32 at 4.8 since January 2020. So you are not weighing $4.99 against nothing at all: you are weighing it against a free app with a public record roughly fifty times deeper.

What the money actually answers is narrow: the AI logo maker and the marquee slider for partner, payment and press logos, neither of which is on the free app's feature list. That is a real difference and it is the whole case for paying.

And treat the sales pitch as a pitch. The listing promises effects that 'boost sales' and logo rows that build 'instant trust'; no conversion data is published for either claim, by this vendor or by the free ones. Note too what the recent reviews are built from: three of the newest come from stores that had the app installed for ten minutes, about three hours and nine months respectively, so most of that 4.8 says the install went smoothly, not that the thing kept working.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $29.94 a year, 7-day trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/custom-falling-effect and in our own test the same day; earlier reads 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-20 on the same listing, when the monthly plan was $2.99) Billed in USD, with recurring charges billed every 30 days. The listing shows two plans. The Development Stores plan is free, includes every feature, and the listing states its limit plainly: development and partner stores only, with payment activated on upgrade. Monthly Plan is $4.99 a month, or $29.94 a year with a saving the listing now puts at 50%, with a 7 day free trial, and the listing's feature list carries the falling effect, the AI Logo Maker, custom image upload, page choice, speed, size and density controls, the Logo Slider marquee carousel, dozens of holiday presets, support for all themes and live chat support. The price rose between our 20 October and 17 November 2026 readings: the monthly plan was $2.99 and the yearly plan $28.70 until then. In our own test on a Shopify development store the app did not offer the free plan: it opened on a plan screen with the Yearly Plan at $2.50 a month billed annually, marked “SALE: Save 50%”, and the Monthly Plan at $4.99 a month, with a note that each store gets at most 7 trial days altogether, and its settings stayed locked until a plan was approved. The in app plan cards list the falling effect, own image upload, design, placement, all themes and live chat, and do not mention the AI Logo Maker or the Logo Slider that the listing lists. Shopify's approval screen for the Monthly Plan showed $4.99 every 30 days after a 7 day trial ending 24 November, with an Add payment method row and Approve greyed out until a method is added; we added none, so we did not approve it. Effective Apps' own site, effectify.io, publishes no pricing page at all — /pricing and /apps both return 404, checked on 20 September 2026, and the home page carries no prices — so unlike most Shopify apps there is no upper half of the ladder hiding on a vendor site. What the listing shows is the whole price record.

compare_with.name: Dakaas Seasonal Effects
compare_with.why:
Both put falling effects on a Shopify storefront, both carry the Built for Shopify badge, and one of them is free. Dakaas lists 200+ holiday themes plus cursor effects, music and scheduling, and has 1,567 reviews at 4.9 since May 2021; Imgify has 32 reviews at 4.8 since January 2020 and costs $4.99 a month or $29.94 a year.

The comparison goes Imgify's way on one axis only, and it is a narrow one: your own brand rather than the season. The AI logo maker that generates falling artwork from a short prompt, and the marquee slider for partner, payment and press logos, are not on the Dakaas feature list. If you want snow for December, Dakaas does it for nothing and far more merchants have vouched for it. If you want your logo falling down the page, Imgify is the one that does that, and at $4.99 the price is not the part of this decision worth agonising over.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session installed Imgify (Imgify Falling Effect in the admin) on a Shopify development store. The app opened on a plan choice with a Yearly and a Monthly plan and no free or Development plan, and the Shopify approval screen for the Monthly Plan asked for a payment method before anything else, so the falling effect was not tested. The app was uninstalled; nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at about 21:58 in our own tab; the Shopify dialog Install app asked for View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Online Store, Shopify admin) and was approved at about 22:01. The app opened as Imgify Falling Effect. Core action NOT DONE: the first screen is a plan choice (Welcome to Imgify: Logo Animation Effects, Pick your plan to start a 7-days* free trial) and the app gives no access to settings before a plan is chosen and approved. No Development plan and no free plan were offered. Plans in the app: Yearly Plan $2.50/month billed annually (SALE: Save 50%, Recommended) and Monthly Plan $4.99/month billed monthly; each store gets at most 7 trial days altogether. The cards list your own image, a customizable design, placement, all themes and live chat; AI Logo Maker and Logo Slider are not on the cards. Checkout: Start free trial on the Monthly Plan opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov, $4,99 USD every 30 days, subtotal $4,99 plus any applicable taxes, total $4,99 due 24 Nov, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The line You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen, so nothing was approved and no card was entered. Cancel gave the message The shop cannot accept the provided charge. The yearly approval screen was not opened. Cancelling: no subscription existed. Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall opened Uninstall Imgify Falling Effect? with the warning that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and a required reason (Testing multiple apps). Clean up: the app was uninstalled and is gone from Installed; no theme change and no payment. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The listing names a free plan for development stores, but the app on our development store offered only paid plans and opened nothing before a plan was approved; the approval screen needed a payment method and had no test charge line, and Cancel showed an error.
